research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Seismic Therapeutic is engaged in developing polypeptides and molecules, such as Fc fusion molecules and protease variants, for modulating immune system activity. Their research includes variant IgG Fc polypeptides and dual targeted immune regulating compositions, aiming to treat IgG mediated disorders, autoimmune disorders, and cancers by targeting and modulating specific cell types. These activities reflect a focus on immunology drug development using advanced molecular approaches.

overview_description.description: Seismic Therapeutic is a biotechnology company integrating machine learning across the entire biologics discovery process to accelerate immunology drug development. Using its IMPACT™ platform, the company is addressing the central challenges of biologics discovery and development by fully integrating machine learning with the key elements of biologics drug discovery—structural biology, protein engineering, and translational immunology—to create optimized therapies on an accelerated path to patients. Seismic Therapeutic has a pipeline of biologics to address adaptive immune system dysregulation and treat autoimmune diseases.

about_short_description.short_description: Seismic Therapeutic is a biotechnology company developing machine-learning technology for immunology drug development.

product.name: IMPACT Platform
product.description: A machine learning-driven platform integrating structural biology, protein engineering, and translational immunology to accelerate biologics drug discovery for autoimmune diseases.

product.name: S-1117
product.description: An engineered Fc-fused pan-IgG protease designed to cleave IgG autoantibodies for treating autoimmune diseases driven by pathogenic IgG.

product.name: S-4321
product.description: A bifunctional antibody agonizing PD-1 and FcγRIIb inhibitory receptors for autoimmune disease treatment.

product.name: Ig Sculpting Enzymes
product.description: Engineered enzymes that selectively cleave immunoglobulins to modulate autoantibody-driven autoimmune diseases.

product.name: Dual-Cell Bidirectional (DcB) Antibodies
product.description: Antibodies designed to engage both T cells and antigen-presenting cells via inhibitory receptors to regulate immune responses in autoimmune diseases.
